description: Closed set of reasons a feedback submission can fail, shared by submit_feedback.py, the check-feedback-id hook, the instruction surfaces and the hold queue. Identifiers are stable once shipped and are never renamed; a new reason is added only by amending acceptance criterion INF-500d-3.

reasons.meaning: The submitter was not permitted to write the category it named, so nothing was written.
The submission was refused as malformed before anything was written: a bad argument, an unrecognised category, a badly shaped tag or a badly shaped reference list.
The submission facility itself was unavailable: its entry point is missing, a library it depends on is not installed, or its configuration cannot be used, so nothing was written.
The destination for the report could not be written, so the report was lost.
The report was written successfully but the caller did not capture the record identifier, so a stored record exists and must not be filed again.
